description.value: Karahi King is a family-owned and operated Indian restaurant in downtown Prince George, serving traditional dishes cooked in a karahi pot and tandoor clay oven. Located on 5th Ave across from the Ramada Hotel, it is a fully licensed establishment offering dine-in and takeout with an all-you-can-eat lunch buffet. Chef Jagdish Gill won first prize at the 2015 Iron Ore Chef vs. Chef Challenge, and the restaurant is praised locally as one of Prince George's best-kept secrets.

Takeout is explicitly advertised throughout ('Eat In or Take Out!') and the menu includes a dedicated Vegetarian Specialties section. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site.
